purpose: Freeze the current deep-research donor, benchmark, and strongest-runnable-system census before any P2-U naturalistic protected outcome. This removes post-outcome baseline-shopping freedom but does not itself complete the P2-U protocol.

comparison_policy.primary_causal_comparator: A same-host, same-retrieval, same-source-access, same-total-budget donor-complete controller. It must receive all frozen donor mechanics that can be instantiated without privileged gold, including evidence-aware completion, retrieval novelty/coverage control, dependency-guided context sharing, coverage estimation, contradiction handling, route/task accounting, and charged state compilation/cache costs.
comparison_policy.system_level_contemporaneous_comparators: Strong current end-to-end deep-research systems are required as external sanity baselines where runnable, but because model training/backbones may differ they cannot replace the matched-host donor-complete comparator for causal attribution.
comparison_policy.budget_rule: Search calls, retrieved bytes/tokens, model tokens, wall time, external API cost, verifier/evaluator calls used at decision time, state compilation, indexing, caching, and recovery are all charged to the same predeclared task budget. Gold-only evaluator work is outside candidate/comparator budgets and unavailable until capture freezes.
comparison_policy.unavailable_donor_rule: A donor mechanic may not be silently dropped because its original implementation is unavailable. Before protected outcomes either instantiate an outcome-blind functional analogue under the matched host and freeze it, or record the missing implementation as a protocol limitation/CANNOT_CHECK condition for the affected claim.
comparison_policy.post_outcome_change_rule: No baseline, donor, benchmark version, budget, metric, threshold, source universe, or availability exception may be changed after a protected P2-U outcome. A scientifically necessary change requires a separately versioned successor frozen before its outcome.

donor_mechanics.name: HALT
donor_mechanics.integrity_note: The frozen repository revision is after the 2026-08-04 pre-camera-ready result-integrity repair that corrected valid-row denominators and removed skipped/no-claim rows from stop-loop statistics. Earlier result-bearing revisions are not interchangeable without an explicit equivalence audit.

donor_mechanics.name: RAAC
donor_mechanics.role: trajectory-level retrieval novelty and information-coverage signals controlling continue/intervene/stop
donor_mechanics.integrity_note: The arXiv record inspected at freeze did not expose a repository binding. The mechanism remains mandatory donor territory; lack of a bound implementation is not permission to omit its functionality from the matched donor-complete comparator.

donor_mechanics.name: Enterprise Deep Research / Don't Stop Early
donor_mechanics.role: coverage-driven objective decomposition, dependency-guided localized context sharing, and evidence-aware completion

donor_mechanics.name: SAGE
donor_mechanics.role: scientific retrieval benchmark and corpus-level retrieval improvement; prevents treating generic scientific retrieval quality as P2-U novelty

public_benchmark_surfaces.name: LiveDRBench
public_benchmark_surfaces.scope: 100 high-fan-out deep-research tasks with claim/reference evaluation across scientific and public-interest categories
public_benchmark_surfaces.reason: The public test/evaluation surface is useful and demanding but cannot substitute for P2-U hidden naturalistic routes, false-closure custody, or independent held-out transfer.

public_benchmark_surfaces.name: DeepResearch Bench
public_benchmark_surfaces.scope: 100 PhD-level research tasks across 22 fields with current GPT-5.5 RACE and GPT-5.4-mini FACT evaluator configuration
public_benchmark_surfaces.reason: Public benchmark performance does not independently identify route completeness, hidden missed evidence, provider validity, or false task-global closure.

contemporaneous_system_census.name: AgentFounder-30B
contemporaneous_system_census.integrity_note: Repository-reported benchmark scores motivate inclusion as a contemporaneous stress baseline but are not imported as ORION evidence; P2-U must execute and score its own frozen tasks under matched accounting.

protected_trial_requirements_created_by_: Before any naturalistic protected outcome, freeze an execution manifest binding the exact host model/checkpoint or API snapshot, retriever/search APIs, source access, task budget, and every runnable comparator implementation.
The same-host donor-complete controller is mandatory even if a stronger end-to-end system is also tested.

HALT must use revision 2f905b57aaaac3e489ef0554ce6ce978ed72178d or a later revision separately re-frozen before protected outcomes; do not use an older denominator-bug revision as the nominal donor baseline.
RAAC and EDR functionality must be represented in the donor-complete controller or their implementation unavailability must become an explicit claim-limiting/CANNOT_CHECK condition before outcome.

Public LiveDRBench/DeepResearch Bench results are preflight/context only. P2-U authority still requires hidden naturalistic evidence routes, false-closure evaluation, cross-domain/systematic-review-like replication, and independent route/evaluator custody.
Every research task or prospectively frozen task cluster is the inferential unit; repeated samples, search traces, remints, or provider retries are technical repeats and cannot inflate n.
